name: Colour TFT display 1.8in 128x160 (ST7735, SPI)
description: 1.8 in colour TFT, 128 x 160 pixels, RGB565, on the ST7735 controller over SPI (the "black tab" module). Uno wiring: VCC → 5V, GND → GND, CS → D10, A0 (DC) → D9, RESET → D8, SDA (MOSI) → D11, SCK → D13, LED → 5V. Works with Adafruit_ST7735 (Adafruit_ST7735 tft(10, 9, 8); tft.initR(INITR_BLACKTAB);).

pins.label: LED
pins.description: Backlight. HIGH (or unwired: pulled up on the module) = on; analogWrite on a PWM pin dims it.

pins.label: SDA
pins.description: SPI data in (labelled SDA on most modules, but it is SPI MOSI, not I2C). Uno: D11.

pins.label: A0
pins.description: Data / command select (labelled A0 or DC): LOW = command byte, HIGH = data. Uno: D9 (any digital pin).

pins.label: RESET
pins.description: Reset, active low, pulled up on the module. Uno: D8, or -1 in the library.

pins.label: CS
pins.description: Chip select, active low. Uno: D10.

props.label: Logic level
props.description: Most red 1.8in modules run their logic at 3.3 V; on a 5 V Uno add series resistors or a level shifter for real hardware (choose 3v3-only to get the warning).

footprint: 34 x 56 mm module, 8-pin 0.1 in header (LED SCK SDA A0 RESET CS GND VCC), SD slot on the back

bindings.description: The glass shows an image: powered, sleep out (0x11), display on (0x29) and backlight on.
Counts visible changes. Pixels: Simulation.framebuffer(partId) (RGB565, 128 x 160, portrait).
The Adafruit setRotation() value MADCTL matches (0..3, -1 otherwise). 0 and 2 are upright on the canvas.
1 when the glass shows an image (bound in the SVG).
